parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a toilet, typically made of durable plastic. It is a flat, rounded cover attached to the seat by hinges.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the toilet bowl to prevent odors from escaping and to maintain hygiene when the toilet is not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate upward and downward around the hinge axis, allowing it to open and close easily.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic. It includes the bowl, pedestal, and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the user, holds water, and channels waste into the plumbing system through the drain outlet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that remains stationary once installed.
